sets.caption:
Starbucks ko ek coffee cup se aage samjho ☕

FY2026 ke end par 41,607 coffeehouses aur $37.9B consolidated net revenue. July 2026 mein company ne 90 markets mein locations batayi thi. Euromonitor ke mutabik 2025 global specialist coffee aur tea shops category $133B thi. Market-size category ko Starbucks revenue ka direct denominator samajhkar market share mat nikalo—scope aur year alag hain.

Sources: Starbucks FY2026 results https://investor.starbucks.com/news/financial-releases/news-details/2026/Starbucks-Reports-Q4-and-Full-Fiscal-Year-2026-Results/default.aspx ; Starbucks markets https://about.starbucks.com/stories/2026/starbucks-celebrates-the-global-game-by-showcasing-8-of-the-worlds-most-beautiful-coffeehouses/ ; Euromonitor https://www.euromonitor.com/newsroom/press-releases/april-2026/one-in-five-dollars-spent-on-global-foodservice-delivery-in-2025

sets.caption:
Coca-Cola ka scale teen alag numbers se dekho 🥤

2025 mein company ka net operating revenue $47.941B tha aur Coca-Cola system ne 33.8B unit cases beche. Products 200+ countries aur territories mein available hain. Euromonitor ka $1.1T global soft drinks market figure **2024** ka broad industry estimate hai; ise company revenue ya unit-case volume ke saath confuse na karein.

Sources: Coca-Cola 2025 Form 10-K https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/filings-reports/all-sec-filings/content/0001628280-26-010047/ko-20251231.htm ; Euromonitor https://www.euromonitor.com/newsroom/press-releases/june-2025/innovation-and-functionality-drive-global-soft-drinks-market-to-usd1.1-trillion
